# survey-agent

> The agentic survey engine. A survey is a JSON/Markdown document; one small, fixed, pure-Python
> engine interprets it (like a browser runs HTML). An LLM drafts a survey from a plain-English brief,
> stress-tests it on simulated respondents, fixes its own logic, then runs it as a web form or an AI
> conversation. It emits a drop-in `survey_url`, captures answers, and passes results back through a
> pluggable integration. You own the data, you bring your own LLM, and it runs anywhere.

survey-agent is built to be **driven by LLMs like Claude** and **self-hosted by the deployer**. The
engine depends only on the standard library plus `jsonschema`, `PyYAML` and `regex`; everything
else is an optional extra. Storage, panel/CRM passback, enrichment, and the LLM are swappable seams.
Mongo, Render, Firebolt, and Mailchimp appear in this repo only as *reference implementations* of those
seams, never as requirements. Version 0.1.0; the PyPI package ships with the first release, and until
then it installs from GitHub (`pip install "git+https://github.com/paulneto/survey-agent"`).

## Start here (for agents and humans)

- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/paulneto/survey-agent/blob/main/AGENTS.md): how an LLM/agent drives survey-agent end-to-end (author → validate → simulate → approve → launch → report)
- [README.md](https://github.com/paulneto/survey-agent/blob/main/README.md): what it is, the agentic loop, surfaces, and quickstart
- [Quickstart](https://github.com/paulneto/survey-agent/blob/main/docs/QUICKSTART.md): from install to a running survey
- [Docs map](https://github.com/paulneto/survey-agent/blob/main/docs/README.md): every doc and the job it owns
- [server.json](https://github.com/paulneto/survey-agent/blob/main/server.json): MCP registry manifest (run via `uvx --from "survey-agent[mcp,llm]" survey-agent-mcp`)

## Drive it as an agent

- MCP connector: `claude mcp add survey-agent -- uvx --from "survey-agent[mcp,llm]" survey-agent-mcp`. It exposes the loop as typed tools (`save_survey`, `validate_survey`, `simulate_survey`, `critique_survey`, `pretest_survey`, `launch_survey`, `list_surveys`, `survey_report`, …) plus `begin_survey`/`answer_survey` for collecting structured answers from a human mid-task
- Launch gate: when `SURVEY_LAUNCH_APPROVAL_TOKEN` is set, no surface can mark a survey live without that human-supplied token; when it is unset, the local CLI and console can, and the MCP connector and API gateway cannot. Saving or editing a definition never changes what respondents are served: only an approved mark-live moves the registry's `live_version`
- Host capabilities: [docs/AGENT_HOSTS.md](https://github.com/paulneto/survey-agent/blob/main/docs/AGENT_HOSTS.md): which hosts can drive it (Claude Code / Claude desktop / claude.ai / ChatGPT / Codex) and what each can and cannot do
- Skills: [skills/](https://github.com/paulneto/survey-agent/tree/main/skills): the authoring workflow for Claude Code (author-survey, edit-survey, add-logic, test-survey, launch-survey, survey-report, inline-survey)
- CLI: `survey-agent help` (one command per step); most read/check commands take `--json`

## Self-hosting (the deployer brings their own)

- [Choosing your setup](https://github.com/paulneto/survey-agent/blob/main/docs/HOSTING.md): decide what your deployment needs; start simple (the `file` store, any host) and add complexity only when you must
- [docs/LOGIC_IS_DATA.md](https://github.com/paulneto/survey-agent/blob/main/docs/LOGIC_IS_DATA.md): the central design decision: conditions are a bounded JSON AST (6 ref kinds, 16 operators, 6 action types, no `eval`), why, and what `validate` vs `simulate` each catch
- [docs/FEATURE_COVERAGE.md](https://github.com/paulneto/survey-agent/blob/main/docs/FEATURE_COVERAGE.md): capability matrix (supported, partial, not supported, out of scope)
- [docs/ENGINEERING.md](https://github.com/paulneto/survey-agent/blob/main/docs/ENGINEERING.md): architecture, the pure engine, and the storage/integration/enrichment/LLM seams
- [docs/OPERATOR_RESPONSIBILITIES.md](https://github.com/paulneto/survey-agent/blob/main/docs/OPERATOR_RESPONSIBILITIES.md): what the operator owns (durable store, erasure, consent, URL integrity, transport)
- [docs/DATA_SECURITY.md](https://github.com/paulneto/survey-agent/blob/main/docs/DATA_SECURITY.md): what the engine does with data, and what remains the deployer's responsibility

## Reference (not required)

- The `mongo` store, the `firebolt` enrichment adapter, the `mailchimp` integration, and the Render blueprints are worked examples of the seams. Swap in your own; the engine stays unopinionated.
